arch._src: README.md and docs/DETAILS.md; src/allie/model (moe.py, network.py, board.py); src/allie/data/vocab.py; Allie 2.1: its training run's configuration; demo: allie.lichess.api.Allie.analyze on the released checkpoint (int8, CPU)

demo._src: allie.lichess.api.Allie.analyze, released Allie 2.0 (int8 CPU), time control 180+2; outputs: 1800 vs 1750, clocks 180, 180, 179 s; human: both players at each rating, no clocks

search._src: src/allie/lichess/calibration.py (the shipped per-cell search budgets) and the analyses in analysis/elo_strength/ behind it; elo = mean of the accuracy and blunder-rate Elo gaps vs humans; ce = human-move CE minus the raw policy's, nats

schematic._note: illustrative numbers for the explanatory beats, not measurements
